{"draft": "O'Reilly Second-Quarter Profit and Sales Rise
O'Reilly Automotive reported higher second-quarter results, with sales rising 8% to $4.89 billion from $4.53 billion a year earlier as comparable store sales increased 6.0%.
Gross profit grew to $2.52 billion, or 51.4% of sales, while operating income climbed to $986 million, or 20.2% of sales. Selling, general and administrative expenses rose to $1.53 billion.
Net income increased 7% to $715 million. Diluted earnings per common share jumped 10% to $0.86, compared with $0.78 a year earlier.
For the first six months of 2026, O'Reilly said sales advanced to $9.45 billion and net income reached $1.32 billion. Diluted earnings per common share for the period rose to $1.58.
The company said it repurchased 16.7 million shares during the second quarter at an average price of $90.40 per share, for a total investment of $1.51 billion.
O'Reilly raised its full-year 2026 comparable store sales guidance to a range of 4% to 6%. The company said it had opened 110 net new stores year to date across North America and was on track for 225 to 235 net new store openings in 2026."}
